metadata.description: Advanced Claude Code plugins for enforced dev workflows and best practices.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Enforced dev workflow (/dev + /spec + /prd) with dual-model review, independent evaluator architecture, AC-driven MODULE progress, aligned §N.M section numbering, ADR (Architecture Decision Records) system, upstream-alignment escape hatches, worktree-parallel /dev, read-only `/dev board` snapshot dashboard, a system-acceptance witness layer, and template-version drift visibility. Includes `dev`, `spec`, `prd` skills plus opt-in statusline. Latest: 3.0.0 `/spec upgrade-template` runs evaluator-backed system-acceptance journey discovery (dual-evaluator, loop-until-dry — finds under-classified REQs + emergent cross-module journeys; degrades to single-evaluator/heuristic) and Phase 1.3 hardens to loop-until-dry emergent-journey discovery (MAJOR: breaks the prior UT.10 no-evaluator contract). Earlier: 2.10.0 system-acceptance layer (REQ `Witness:e2e` + `docs/SYSTEM-ACCEPTANCE.md` + /dev DoD hard gate), 2.11.0 `/spec upgrade-template` adopts it into existing projects without a full rerun, 2.12.0 template-version drift visibility (per-skill banner + session↔installed drift + artifact `dev-template` stamps).

plugins.name: claude-best-practice
plugins.description: Claude Code best practices: explore-plan-code discipline, verification-first development, context management, prompt scoping, and session strategy.

plugins.name: code-companion
plugins.description: macOS Dynamic Island for code agents. Floating status pill shows pending approvals and active sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI. Click to jump to terminal.

plugins.name: telegram-channels-pro
plugins.description: Telegram-channels-pro daemon: single-instance Telegram bot daemon + Unix-socket MCP transport for claude sessions, sliding-window quarantine reliability (RC#1 fix), watchdog (orphan/stuck/idle), first-run admin registration window, structured JSON logs with redaction. v0.1 infrastructure slice — daemon-core + telegram-client + mcp-server-proxy (daemon side) + admin-auth + observability. M004 mcp-tools, M005 routing, M007 deployment ship in a subsequent release.
